name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-08-04, at wavelengths from 1.58 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
